WITH grade_map AS (
  SELECT 'UG' AS grade, -1 AS grade_order UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PK', 0 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'KG', 1 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 13
),
eligible_high_schools AS (
  -- Currently operating high schools in the given district, must ENROLL students in grade 12
  SELECT
    s.NCESSchool,
    s.School,
    s.NCESDist,
    s.GSserved,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.StatusType
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Open'
    AND (
         s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
    )
),
zero_sat_schools AS (
  -- Schools with zero or no SAT test takers
  SELECT ehs.*
  FROM eligible_high_schools ehs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON ehs.NCESSchool = ss.cds
  WHERE COALESCE(ss.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0
),
start_grades AS (
  SELECT
    zss.School,
    zss.GSserved,
    MIN(gm.grade_order) AS min_grade_order
  FROM zero_sat_schools zss
  JOIN grade_map gm ON ',' || zss.GSserved || ',' LIKE '%,' || gm.grade || ',%'
  GROUP BY zss.School, zss.GSserved
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(min_grade_order) AS earliest_grade_order FROM start_grades
)
SELECT sg.School, sg.GSserved
FROM start_grades sg
JOIN earliest e ON sg.min_grade_order = e.earliest_grade_order
ORDER BY sg.School
LIMIT 1000

WITH target_county AS (
  SELECT "County Name" AS county_name
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
filtered_schools AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."County Name" AS county_name,
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS is_charter,
    f.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS enrollment_k12,
    f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_k12,
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_k12,
    ROUND(1.0 * f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] / NULLIF(f.[Enrollment (K-12)],0) * 100, 2) AS pct_free,
    ROUND(1.0 * f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] / NULLIF(f.[Enrollment (K-12)],0) * 100, 2) AS pct_frpm
  FROM frpm f 
  JOIN target_county tc ON f."County Name" = tc.county_name
  WHERE 
    f.[Enrollment (K-12)] IS NOT NULL AND
    f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500
    AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
    AND f.[School Type] = 'K-12'
),
schools_with_sats AS (
  SELECT 
    fs.CDSCode,
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS sat_total
  FROM satscores s
  JOIN filtered_schools fs ON s.cds = fs.CDSCode
  WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  fs.county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(fs.pct_free), 2) AS avg_free_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(fs.pct_frpm), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.is_charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.is_charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter,
  ROUND(AVG(sws.sat_total), 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM filtered_schools fs
LEFT JOIN schools_with_sats sws ON fs.CDSCode = sws.CDSCode
GROUP BY fs.county_name
LIMIT 1000

WITH county_info AS (
  SELECT "County Code", "County Name"
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_frpm AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, MAX("Academic Year") as max_year
    FROM frpm
    GROUP BY CDSCode
  ) x ON f.CDSCode = x.CDSCode AND f."Academic Year" = x.max_year
),
grade_normal AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER("Low Grade") IN ('pk','tk','p','0') THEN 0
      WHEN LOWER("Low Grade") IN ('k','kg') THEN 1
      WHEN CAST("Low Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE CAST("Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
    END AS low_grade_as_int,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST("High Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 12 THEN 12
      WHEN LOWER("High Grade") IN ('12') THEN 12
      ELSE COALESCE(CAST("High Grade" AS INTEGER), 0)
    END AS high_grade_as_int
  FROM latest_frpm
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM grade_normal
  WHERE
    "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0

WITH commander_sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    s.code AS set_id,
    s.name AS set_name,
    s.releaseDate,
    s.parentCode,
    s.totalSetSize
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.type = 'commander'
    AND s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
),
commander_grouped AS (
  SELECT
    cs.set_id,
    cs.set_name,
    cs.releaseDate,
    cs.parentCode,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN s2.type IN ('commander', 'promo', 'box', 'duel_deck', 'draft_invention', 'token', 'memorabilia', 'special') AND s2.parentCode = cs.set_id THEN s2.totalSetSize
        WHEN cs.set_id = s2.code AND s2.type = 'commander' THEN s2.totalSetSize
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS total_card_count
  FROM commander_sets_2020 cs
  LEFT JOIN sets s2 ON (s2.parentCode = cs.set_id OR s2.code = cs.set_id)
  WHERE IFNULL(s2.type, 'commander') NOT IN ('alchemy', 'alchemy_play')
  GROUP BY cs.set_id, cs.set_name, cs.releaseDate, cs.parentCode
),
max_card_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_card_count) AS max_total_card_count
  FROM commander_grouped
)
SELECT
  cg.set_id,
  cg.set_name,
  cg.total_card_count,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.language)
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.setCode = cg.set_id
  ) AS official_language_count
FROM commander_grouped cg, max_card_count mcc
WHERE cg.total_card_count = mcc.max_total_card_count
ORDER BY cg.set_id ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH match_home_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.away_team_api_id,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal,
    m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal AS goal_diff
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
), 
last_speed_attr AS (
  SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.date AS attr_date, ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id, ta.date ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC) rn
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
),
team_attr_at_match AS (
  SELECT mw.match_id, mw.home_team_api_id,
         (
           SELECT ta2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
           FROM Team_Attributes ta2
           WHERE ta2.team_api_id = mw.home_team_api_id
             AND date(ta2.date) <= date(mw.match_date)
           ORDER BY date(ta2.date) DESC, ta2.id DESC
           LIMIT 1
         ) AS buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM match_home_wins mw
),
fast_home_wins AS (
  SELECT tam.match_id, tam.home_team_api_id
  FROM team_attr_at_match tam
  WHERE tam.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),
club_win_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.id,
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(fhw.match_id) AS fast_home_wins
  FROM fast_home_wins fhw
  JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = fhw.home_team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)
SELECT team_long_name AS club_name, team_short_name, fast_home_wins
FROM club_win_counts
WHERE fast_home_wins = (SELECT MAX(fast_home_wins) FROM club_win_counts)
   OR fast_home_wins >= 1
ORDER BY fast_home_wins DESC, club_name
LIMIT 1000

  SELECT od.account_id, od.owner_district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region, d.A4 AS district_area, d.A11 AS district_population
  FROM owner_districts od
  INNER JOIN district d ON od.owner_district_id = d.district_id
),
outside_counterparties AS (
  -- Only take transfers (type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') for incoming/outgoing, operation with 'VYBER' = cash withdrawal, 'VKLAD' = cash deposit, ignore these)
  -- Counterparty only if: bank IS NOT NULL AND bank != '' AND operation NOT IN ('VYBER', 'VKLAD')
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (CAST(t.bank AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT))) AS n_unique_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != ''
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    AND (t.operation IS NULL OR t.operation NOT IN ('VYBER', 'VKLAD'))
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
binded AS (
  SELECT ba.account_id, ba.acct_open_date, ba.total_borrowed, 
         op.district_name, op.district_population, 
         oc.n_unique_counterparties
  FROM borrowing_accounts ba
  INNER JOIN owner_population op ON ba.account_id = op.account_id
  LEFT JOIN outside_counterparties oc ON ba.account_id = oc.account_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC) AS population_rank
  FROM binded
)
SELECT account_id, acct_open_date, total_borrowed, 
       COALESCE(n_unique_counterparties, 0) AS outside_bank_counterparties,

       population_rank

district_ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.district_id,

    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND c.gender = 'F'
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
),
ranked_female_loans AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) as rank_amt
    FROM female_loans
),
largest_female_loans AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked_female_loans WHERE rank_amt <= 3
),

account_trans AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),

income_category AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id,
           CASE
               WHEN at.total_deposit > 2 * l.amount THEN 'High Income'
               WHEN at.total_deposit > l.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
               ELSE 'Low Income'
           END AS income_category
    FROM largest_female_loans l
    LEFT JOIN account_trans at ON l.account_id = at.account_id
),

region_info AS (
    SELECT d.A2 as district_name, d.A3 as region, d.district_id, d.A11 as avg_salary
    FROM district d
),

loans_in_region AS (
    SELECT ri.region, COUNT(*) as loans_in_region
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN region_info ri ON a.district_id = ri.district_id

),
region_salary AS (

    FROM region_info

),
region_of_loan AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, ri.region, ri.district_name
    FROM largest_female_loans l
    JOIN region_info ri ON l.account_district = ri.district_id
),
age_calc AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, 
           (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 
            (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) AS age_on_date
    FROM client c
),
loan_deposit_join AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.client_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, l.account_id, l.birth_date, l.account_district,
           at.trans_count, COALESCE(at.total_deposit,0) AS total_deposit
    FROM largest_female_loans l
    LEFT JOIN account_trans at ON l.account_id = at.account_id
)

SELECT 
    ldj.client_id,
    ldj.amount AS loan_amount,
    ldj.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(ldj.payments * ldj.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(ldj.payments * ldj.duration - ldj.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    ldj.status AS loan_status,
    rol.district_name,
    rol.region,
    ldj.trans_count AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(ldj.total_deposit, 2) AS total_deposits,
    ic.income_category,
    lir.loans_in_region,
    rsa.region_avg_salary,
    ac.age_on_date AS client_age_20261009
FROM loan_deposit_join ldj
JOIN region_of_loan rol ON ldj.loan_id = rol.loan_id
JOIN income_category ic ON ldj.loan_id = ic.loan_id
JOIN loans_in_region lir ON rol.region = lir.region
JOIN region_salary rsa ON rol.region = rsa.region
JOIN age_calc ac ON ldj.client_id = ac.client_id
ORDER BY loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

           ELSE 0
         END as elevated
  FROM thrombosis_women t
  JOIN latest_rnp_per_patient lr ON t.ID = lr.ID
)

FROM interpreted_rnp
LIMIT 1000

  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT elem1 || '-' || elem2) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM bond_element_pairs
  GROUP BY bond_type
)
SELECT 
  bc.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol, 
  bc.num_bonds, 
  epc.num_element_pairs,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_counts bc
JOIN element_pair_counts epc ON bc.bond_type = epc.bond_type
CROSS JOIN molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bc.num_bonds DESC, bc.bond_type ASC;

WITH bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element,
    COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM bonded_atoms
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND multiple_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH all_atom_bonds AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
atom_bond_agg AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element, 
         MIN(bond_type) AS min_bond_type, 
         MAX(bond_type) AS max_bond_type, 
         COUNT(*) AS total_bonds
  FROM all_atom_bonds
  GROUP BY atom_id, element
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_agg
WHERE min_bond_type = '-' AND max_bond_type = '-'
  AND total_bonds > 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 1000

  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
all_atoms AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, substr(bond_id, 1, instr(bond_id, '-')-1) AS atom_id
  FROM triple_bond_ids
  UNION ALL
  SELECT molecule_id, substr(bond_id, instr(bond_id, '-')+1) AS atom_id
  FROM triple_bond_ids
)
SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM all_atoms aa
JOIN atom a ON aa.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND aa.atom_id = a.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

WITH target_molecule AS (
  SELECT molecule_id

  WHERE label = 'TR397'
),

tr397_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM target_molecule)
),

tr397_bonded_atoms AS (
  -- Atoms from TR397 that are in at least one bond (as atom_id or atom_id2)
  SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
  FROM tr397_atoms a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),

count_by_element AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(*) as n_bonded_atoms
  FROM tr397_bonded_atoms
  GROUP BY element
)

SELECT element, n_bonded_atoms
FROM count_by_element
